  PROBLEM: The security-pass eligibility check in `gate_final_ci_now_green_merge_route` does not apply the `GENERATED_CHORE` exemption that the doc-only/small-diff path applies at line 1688 (documented at lines 1685-1686: "A generated chore PR ... neither needs the pass nor is held on the codex-agent path for it").
  WHY: A generated-chore PR whose failed final CI later turns green reaches this helper. With `AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS=false`, it is blocked with reason=security_pass and never routed, which recreates the #10023 stall that #10183 removes. With the skip-job pass on, it runs an unneeded security pass, and an exhausted pass applies `ai:security-pass-failed`, after which the PR stays blocked. The 1-line fix adds `&& [ "${GENERATED_CHORE:-false}" != "true" ]`. Severity is disputed: four reviewers rated it MAJOR and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT; the highest, MAJOR, is used here.

The path is reachable: a chore PR (GENERATED_CHORE=true, line 1439) with an `ai:final-ci-failed:v1` marker has its skip suppressed (lines 1729-1743), then takes the final_ci_now_green branch (lines 2050-2068).
  WHY: With AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS=true, the skip-merge job runs an unneeded security pass and holds the merge. An exhausted pass applies `ai:security-pass-failed`, and later runs log `not_routed reason=security_pass detail=security_pass_failed`. With AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS=false, the PR is never routed (`detail=skip_job_pass_off`), which keeps the #10023 stall. The fix is `&& [ "${GENERATED_CHORE:-false}" != "true" ]`; the `:-false` default is needed because GENERATED_CHORE is only assigned at line 1409.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh gate_final_ci_now_green_merge_route eligibility `if` (line 1892): add `&& [ "${GENERATED_CHORE:-false}" != "true" ] \`. Estimated lines changed: 1. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- Trust boundary verified as NONE: fork heads are stopped at lines 225-232, FORCE_REVIEW is set at line 1203, and the merge guards in review_autofix.yml:1225-1743 stay bound to the gate head.
- TASK GAPS: NONE. All #10183 deliverables are present, and the "full test suite passes" item was explicitly not reported because 22 check runs show failed_count=0 and the 53 failures are inherited.
